item.title: AI Paranoia
item.description: I now live in a constant state of AI-induced paranoia. Every time I read an article on the internet or watch a YouTube video I’m constantly trying to figure out if it was written by AI or not. I look out for the infamous tells of negative parallelism (“it’s not this, it’s that”), a surplus of m-dashes, and other numerous verbal ticks like “Honestly”, “Here’s the kicker” and “Delve into”.
